reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:125-131, @mixin order($val) passes $val directly to -webkit-box-ordinal-group (line 126) and -moz-box-ordinal-group (line 127) without offsetting by +1. Since legacy box-ordinal-group is 1-based (initial value 1, requiring positive integers per the 2009 Flexbox draft and legacy WebKit) while order is 0-based, values are off by one relative to unstyled siblings and 0 is invalid.
